tasks.label: Finish Rhea asset cleanup
args: $root = (Get-Location).Path; Set-Location $root; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'assets\images\products','assets\images\renders','assets\images\design' | Out-Null; Move-Item -LiteralPath 'Flasche_schwarz (1).png' -Destination 'assets\images\products\rhea-bottle-black-detail.png' -Force; Move-Item -LiteralPath 'Alle einsichten.png' -Destination 'assets\images\design\rhea-design-overviews.png' -Force; Move-Item -LiteralPath 'Gemini_Generated_Image_z50ej3z50ej3z50e.png' -Destination 'assets\images\renders\rhea-bottle-render-01.png' -Force; Move-Item -LiteralPath 'Gemini_Generated_Image_d0ktj5d0ktj5d0kt_nobg_preview_photiu.ai.png' -Destination 'assets\images\renders\rhea-bottle-lifestyle-clean.png' -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'Gemini_Generated_Image_z50ej3z50ej3z50e.jfif','Gemini_Generated_Image_ujc3duujc3duujc3.jfif','Gemini_Generated_Image_u8fo40u8fo40u8fo.png','Gemini_Generated_Image_u8fo40u8fo40u8fo.jfif','Gemini_Generated_Image_d0ktj5d0ktj5d0kt.jfif','UML_Rhea.png' -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath 'assets\images\logos\rhea-logo-mark.png','assets\images\logos\rhea-logo-full.png' -Force

tasks.label: Firebase deploy Rhea
args: set "PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%" && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project rhea-119bb

tasks.label: Firebase deploy debug
args: set "PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%" && npx --yes firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project rhea-119bb --debug

tasks.label: Firebase deploy global
args: set "PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%" && firebase deploy --only hosting --project rhea-119bb

tasks.label: Check JavaScript syntax
args: set "PATH=C:\Program Files\nodejs;%PATH%" && node --check assets\js\product.js && node --check assets\js\legal-consent.js
